d: We are looking for a technically-minded engineer to participate in managing and developing our ETL infrastructure. Our current system includes various tools and services such as workflow management systems, message brokers, a data lake, a data warehouse, and infrastructure-as-code tools.

In addition to everyday activities, we have room to improve our data management processes. Mainly, this involves adapting and refactoring ETL systems to accommodate company growth; other areas include performance and data governance. This role is a great fit if you have a deep understanding of specific areas within data engineering or the confidence to manage the full scope of requirements listed below. Above all, we value good programmers even if they lack experience in other areas.
q: Strong programming skills, e.g., experience with several programming languages or Python frameworks
Software design skills - software design patterns, application design
Data system design or cloud systems experience (AWS, GCP, message brokers, object storage, query engines)
Strong SQL skills, including the ability to apply subqueries, window functions, and CTEs
Warehouse design or ETL systems design experience
PySpark or other distributed systems knowledge, e.g., distributed computing, performance optimization
Experience with or ability to use infrastructure as code, e.g., AWS CloudFormation
Experience with or ability to use the Databricks platform
